text:
Jordan: Thanks everyone for today — this thread for follow-ups on the security deep-dive (logs, KMS, VPC). I'll capture quick Qs and who owns them.
Maya: Appreciate it. Quick question: for SOC2 evidence, what's the plan for automated audit exports? Is there a retention SLA we can promise externally?
Leah: Short answer: we have 1 year hot + 4 years cold planned in the roadmap, but we need to confirm retention SLA for Dedicated customers. Ops currently keeps 3 years by default.
Alex: For Dedicated we can expose a configurable retention setting, but need product decision on max allowed vs compliance.
Sasha: Legal: SOC2 evidence needs chain-of-custody notes for exported logs (who exported, when, purpose). We should add labels to exports.
Maya: Good call. Can we add metadata automatically when somebody runs export?
Leah: Yep — we'll add an audit field in the export manifest. Proposed manifest snippet: ```{
  "export_id": "uuid",
  "initiator": "<user>",
  "purpose": "<ticket/assessment>",
  "timestamp": "iso-8601",
  "md5": "<file-hash>"
}```
Jordan: Nice. Who picks up implementation?
Leah: I can take the export manifest + S3 lifecycle changes. Will need a cross-team PR for API surface.
Maya: I'll own the product decision for retention tiers and what we document publicly (SOC2 FAQ).
Alex: On KMS/BYOK — question from infra: do we support HSM-backed keys for Private customers or only cloud KMS?
Sasha: From compliance POV, HSM-backed BYOK is preferred for certain regulated customers. We should support both and document guarantees.
Leah: Technical constraint: HSM integration adds Ops burden for rotation and audits. We should scope a pilot first.
Jordan: Can we add a note: "Pilot HSM BYOK for two enterprise customers Q2"?
Maya: I'll add that to roadmap and mark it "enterprise pilot".
Alex: For the VPC questions — does Private support VPC peering + PrivateLink today? Customer asked about VPC flow logs export into their SIEM.
Leah: We support PrivateLink for control plane connections and VPC peering for data plane in the private package. Flow logs can be exported to customer S3/CloudWatch with a signed role.
Maya: Action: publish a step-by-step guide with example infra bits (IAM role, flow log filter, sample policy).
Jordan: Can you list the short tasks and owners here so we can close?
Maya: Sure: 
- Publish SOC2 evidence FAQ + retention tiers (owner: maya, due: 2026-03-30) :thumbsup:
- Implement export manifest + audit labels (owner: leah, due: 2026-04-07)
- Pilot HSM BYOK for 2 customers (owner: maya + alex, due: 2026-06-15)
- VPC flow log export guide (owner: alex, due: 2026-03-28)
- Add chain-of-custody field to evidence runbook (owner: sasha, due: 2026-04-01)
Jordan: Thanks — small ask: can the export command include the manifest automatically? Example we discussed: 
Leah: Example export: ```./redwood-export --from s3://redwood-audit-logs/2026-03-22.gz --to ./evidence/2026-03-22.gz --attach-manifest```. The backend will create manifest JSON and attach alongside the file.
Maya: Who will own the public-facing wording for Dedicated SLA? I can draft but need legal signoff.
Sasha: I'll review once you have initial draft. Please tag me in the doc.
Alex: One technical question that came up during demo: if we do cross-region failover, do audit logs replicate automatically?
Leah: We replicate metadata and key indexes, but full log replication depends on retention tier and replication settings. We'll add replication options to the runbook.
Jordan: One more: any blockers for customers to introspect KMS key rotation history?
Leah: We expose rotation timestamps and key version ids via the control plane API. For HSM we may have additional attestations.
Maya: Ok. I'll consolidate these tasks and follow up with a short Confluence page — link will be posted here when ready.
Jordan: Awesome. Closing notes: thanks for quick turns. If anyone needs the SOC2 evidence checklist earlier, DM maya.
